description: The agent systems Actor routes to, with what each can do, its trust class, its rate card and whether it is available now (GET /api/v1/agent-systems, also GET /api/v1/agents for callers with no person's session; actor.agent-list-result@2, whose model tiers and models say which model each tier resolved to), which one a task would go to in a mode, with the reason for every candidate (POST /api/v1/route { task, mode }, a platform.placement-result@1; nothing runs), and the four agent-contact presets a signed-in person can copy (GET /api/v1/agents/presets: Researcher, Inbox, Studio editor, Party host). Public; no token needed. A signed-in person's GET /api/v1/agents answers their own contacts (actor.agent-list@1) instead, so the catalog keeps this explicit path for them too.
